patch.value: Investigate tracker hash discontinuity after older SDK normalization

The first Round 3 claim writes used the changelog-only SDK 2026.10.9 instead of the repo-pinned oracle 2026.10.14. That parser dropped linked-test updater metadata before hashing: history verification now reports before_hash_mismatch at entry 44 for pm-rust-bj7a and entry 74 for pm-rust-unih. All original history prefixes are byte-identical and current items match latest after_hash values. Subsequent writes use the pinned oracle. Preserve append-only records; investigate a forward-compatible migration or verifier strategy without re-anchoring or rewriting history. Default strict health skips history_drift, so its pass must not be described as history integrity.

value.text: PR #92 second-review check reconfirms the existing discontinuities: full health --strict-exit reports history_drift_chain_mismatch for pm-rust-bj7a and pm-rust-unih.
